text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then how about this property? A high-rise 
condo with a panoramic view of the 
gorgeous turquoise blue ocean!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I know about the Dubai races, but real 
estate there... I have no clue.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? Where you live is important 
though~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Refreshed in an elegant mosaic-tiled spa~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
After getting all snoozy-woozy in the 
fluffy bed of a boutique hotel~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—If she enters a race, 1st place is 
practically guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see... That certainly seems likely to 
have a major impact on performance.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right~? Duramente-san, you think so 
too, don't you~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
For example, what if you lined an entire 
room with horseshoes for Duramente-san?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... A room dedicated solely to 
horseshoes, is it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, let's put up a golden horseshoe! I 
wonder if they sell them at the Gold 
Souk~?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Considering the weight of gold, wouldn't 
that increase the chances of throwing a 
shoe?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, doesn't it get you hyped? Getting 
to pick out horseshoes like choosing an 
outfit for going out— that's gotta be fun!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Keeping options open depending on 
condition... That is one way to look at 
it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right? When I move to Dubai, maybe I'll 
make one whole room dedicated to 
horseshoes~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I wonder which place would 
be best... ...Ah, what about this one?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"There's a pool on the terrace, and it's 
close to the Gold Souk too~♪"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so the Gold Souk has tons of beautiful 
gold crafts for sale, and it's not gaudy 
or anything, but super sparkly and shiny—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Isn't this rent amount rather 
unrealistic? I doubt it will serve as a 
useful reference."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Awesome, awesome! First, you just pick 
your favorite dream. Then, all you gotta 
do is work hard toward it!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see. You really are quite goal-oriented, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Vivlos happily chatting with 
Duramente. They're probably talking about 
Dubai.
choice_data_list: Sounds fun. Are you talking about Dubai?
Sounds fun. Are you talking about Dubai?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup~♪ Hey, hey, Trainy, if you were to 
live in Dubai, what kind of place would 
you like?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Being close to the station, the floor 
plan, the interior design... there's so 
much to think about, isn't there?~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But remember, dream big, okay? Let's 
put the "realistic" stuff aside for now!
choice_data_list: What if we built it ourselves?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Then I want Sorachika~, Sorachika~♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Near-port"? ...Like "near-station"? So 
you mean... a property close to the 
airport?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No~pe, it means exactly what it sounds 
like! Close to the sky, so it's 
'Sky-Close'~♪
choice_data_list: What kind of property is it, then?
What kind of property is it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Here it is! The room closest to the sky in 
the whole wide world♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The property Vivlos showed me was a room 
on the top floor of an ultra-high-rise 
building.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So, scratch that for nooooow!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"It's just like a castle in the clouds! 
I'd love to live there someday~♪ Alright, 
I'm gonna give it my all for that!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That kind of thing is totally fine! Come 
on, let's do our best, Trainy♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, what's that?! I love it, love it! 
Trainie, you've got such high-quality 
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You see, Dubai does all kinds of 
fascinating things, like building massive 
artificial islands and constructing houses 
with 3D printers♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"So I'm sure any dream can come true! I 
mean, we even have a mansion with a pool, 
after all—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We might even be able to build a mansion 
with its own racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A house with a racetrack attached, huh? 
That sounds amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? Being able to dream all 
kinds of dreams is what makes Dubai so 
great♪ For example, there's—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like their talk about Dubai was 
going to continue for quite a while.
